data.cultural_impact: The name "Eshanansh" is a combination of two Sanskrit words - "Eshana" and "Ansh." In Hindu mythology, Eshana is revered as the Lord of the Universe, a deity who controls all creations and phenomena. The name is a reminder of the vast cosmos we live in and our connections to it. In everyday life, "Eshanansh" could be seen as a reminder of the interconnectedness of all beings and the countless blessings from the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: This name carries significant spiritual significance as it symbolizes the presence and power of God in the universe, as well as within each individual. "Ansh" in the name signifies the divine presence or the breath of life that sustains us all. The name serves as a reminder to observe and appreciate the divine presence everywhere and in every moment, and to live in gratitude and devotion to the supreme power.
